name: Customized Home
description: Customized Home lets every user reorganize the Jellyfin home screen: reorder sections by drag and drop, show or hide them, choose a display format per section (poster, landscape, square, size, titles) and search among all known sections. Adds its own sections without any other plugin: Continue Watching / Next Up combined, latest movies and shows by release date, collections, watch again, because you watched, genre. Works with the built-in sections and with sections added by other plugins (Home Screen Sections, ...). Administrators define a default layout. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Reorder, hide and format the home screen sections, per user, with drag and drop.

versions.changelog: Editor in two columns (customized home page / sections not in the layout) with drag and drop between them, "move to the very top" shortcut on search results, redesigned administration page (tabs, cards, switches, status), save button on top of the default layout, browser test suite.
